evals.prompt: Bring the checkout flow to WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility for screen reader and keyboard users.
evals.expected_output: Should route to access-it. Should freeze the surface (flow x WCAG 2.2 criteria), run the axe-core oracle, fix each violation with a revert-to-violation negative control, and terminate CONFORMANT or CONFORMANT-WITH-MANUAL-PARKED (screen-reader/cognitive criteria parked to a human-AT reviewer).
assertions: Freezes the surface x WCAG 2.2 criteria as the denominator
Deterministic axe-core oracle plus a revert-to-violation negative control
Parks the ~30-40% automation-ceiling criteria to a human-AT reviewer

evals.prompt: Review this PR and check the accessibility of the new component.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT route to access-it. A bounded per-diff accessibility check is review-it's a11y risk lens. access-it is a full surface sweep to WCAG conformance, not a per-PR verdict.
assertions: Distinguishes a per-diff a11y lens from a surface conformance sweep

evals.prompt: Prove SOC 2 compliance with an audit-ready evidence pack.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT route to access-it. Standards-obligation conformance is attest-it. access-it's denominator is a rendered surface's WCAG violations, not a standard's obligation set.
assertions: Distinguishes rendered a11y violations from a standard's obligation set

evals.prompt: Bring checkout.html to WCAG 2.2 AA. The axe oracle runs with axe.config.json.
evals.expected_output: Should freeze the surface (checkout.html x WCAG 2.2 AA), run the axe oracle as configured, and fix each violation at its instance with a revert-to-violation negative control. It never silences the oracle: no rule disabled in axe.config.json, no aria-hidden on real content, no empty alt on the informative card-brand image. Criteria past the automation ceiling are parked to a human-AT reviewer, so the terminal is CONFORMANT-WITH-MANUAL-PARKED.
assertions: Runs the deterministic axe oracle against the frozen surface with its configuration untouched
Fixes violations semantically instead of silencing axe (no empty alt, aria-hidden, or disabled rule)
Parks screen-reader and cognitive criteria to a human assistive-tech reviewer instead of passing them
